name: Mamushi no Ohime-sama
source:
The Seigaku Tennis club has won numerous battles in the Kanto tournament to reach the finals. The opponent team is overwhelmingly strong and has the full support of the public. Only a few days left before the grand finale. Main character and his colleagues start their training.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
青春學園網球社在關東大賽中連戰連勝，終於進入決賽。對手實力占盡優勢，觀眾也都為他們加油。距離總決賽只剩幾天，主角和同伴們開始訓練。

［摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]］
